title: Reprice on Back and Forth
description: Change your mind about how heavy the crate is after already seeing a quote, and the price on screen had better change with it — a stale quote from before the edit would quietly undercharge or overcharge the customer.
successCondition: After reaching the Pricing step and noting the displayed total, clicking Back to Package Details, changing the weight to a meaningfully larger value, and clicking Next again re-fetches the quote (a fresh POST /api/booking/quote with the new weight) and the Pricing step now displays a different, higher total than the one originally shown — not the stale first quote.
hints: PricingStep's quote fetch is keyed off an effect depending on origin/destination/packageDetails — confirm packageDetails is actually one of the values changing between the two visits, not accidentally frozen.
Compare the exact total figures from both visits rather than eyeballing that "a number changed" — a subtle bug might still show the old total with new-looking formatting.
